Vocalist and guitarist Nick Brummer searched for new band members after the end of pop-punk band Good Things in September 2012, and he found those members in Bart Eijk, Daan Brink and Bas Frishert.  On December 2 the band announced that Daan Brink won't be able to continue playing for The Lost Boys Club anymore.  At December 10, The Lost Boys Club introduced their new drummer Danny Bekker, who was active as the drummer for the Dutch metalcore band Smash The Hourglass.  The band is inspired by the melodies of bands such as Blink-182 and New Found Glory.
